exam_name: SSC CGL Tier-II Paper-2 (Statistics - For JSO Post)
target_audience: Candidates applying for Junior Statistical Officer (JSO)

selection_stages: Stage 2: Tier-II CBT (Paper-I is compulsory, Paper-II is for JSO only)

eligibility.education: Bachelor's Degree in any subject with at least 60% in Mathematics at 12th standard OR Bachelor's Degree with Statistics as one of the subjects at degree level.

subjects.description: Advanced statistical concepts, probability theory, sampling, and data analysis required for the Junior Statistical Officer post.

topics.topic_name: Collection, Classification and Presentation of Statistical Data (Primary/Secondary data, Frequency distributions, Charts/Graphs)
Measures of Central Tendency (Mean, Median, Mode, Partition values)
Measures of Dispersion (Range, Quartile deviations, Mean deviation, Standard deviation, Coefficient of variation)
Moments, Skewness and Kurtosis (Types, Meaning, and Measures)
Correlation and Regression (Scatter diagram, Pearson’s coefficient, Rank correlation, Linear regression)
Probability Theory (Events, Sample space, Bayes' theorem, Conditional Probability)
Random Variable and Probability Distributions (Binomial, Poisson, Normal distributions)
Sampling Theory (Concepts of population and sample, Random and non-random sampling, Sampling distributions)
Statistical Inference (Point & interval estimation, Hypothesis testing, Null & Alternative hypotheses, Errors, p-values)
Analysis of Variance (ANOVA - One-way and Two-way classifications)
Time Series Analysis (Components, Measurement of trend and seasonal variations)
Index Numbers (Meaning, Types, Price relatives, Laspeyre’s, Paasche’s and Fisher’s indices, Cost of living index)
